title: 第677章 道果合一万我归一第676章 神话世界证神话大罗
slug: 我定海神珠拐走人族后六圣懵了
content_zh:
沧源的修为进展太快了。
快到根基尚未彻底稳固。
快到道心没有磨砺到极致。
也就在他证道神话大罗的那一瞬间，道心有缺，心魔蚀体，直接给沧源反噬成傻逼了。
本源动荡。
元神沉寂。
道域的沧源本尊陷入沉眠之中。
而在道域沧源本尊的体内，一场由沧源记忆中的所知的神话体系，衍生成了一座世界。
这座世界的根基是沧源记忆中关于神话的一切。
洪荒、印度神话、希腊万神殿、北欧诸神、埃及九柱神、日本高天原。
全是他还是蓝星林苍时，了解过的神话体系内容。
也就是说。
不管是洪荒的三清盘古，女娲后土，鸿钧天道，还是印度的梵天湿婆神，希腊的宙斯波塞冬等等，全是根据沧源记忆而诞生的。
但由于神话大罗超脱一切，因果循环往复，大道自行运转，那股闭合的逻辑环越转越快，最终彻底演化成了一座完整的、闭环的、自洽的虚假世界。
而那失落神庭。
也是基于林苍前世对克苏鲁神话体系的理解诞生的。
不过却被苍帝窃取。
占为己有。
苍帝的存在也不简单。
实际上，苍帝是另一个世界的林苍。

平行世界。
但在沧源证道大罗之际，收束自身所有的时间线，万我归一，苍帝所处的平行世界也在其中。
不过由于沧源自身出了一些问题。
才没有彻底将苍帝收束自身。
但也为他在自己的体内世界掀起黑潮动乱埋下伏笔。
苍帝不甘自己被收束。
他找到了沧源的半颗大罗道果。
试图炼化。
窃取沧源本尊的大罗果实。
但他高估了自己。
也低估了大罗道果。
历经七座无量大界，无数岁月，苍帝拿那半颗大罗道果毫无办法。
束手无策。
因此。
林苍盯上了，他认为还未觉醒的沧源！
他要将沧源取而代之。
成为那至高无上的大罗金仙！
纵横道域！
一切都是虚假的。
洪荒是虚假的。

诸多神域是虚假的。
content_en:
Cangyuan's cultivation progressed too fast.
The foundation has not yet been completely solidified.
It’s so fast that the Taoist heart has not been sharpened to the extreme.
At the moment when he realized the Tao of the Mythical Great Luo, his Taoist heart was defective, and his inner demons eroded his body, which directly turned Cangyuan into a fool.
The origin is turbulent.
The soul is silent.
Cangyuan's deity in the Dao realm fell into a deep sleep.
In the body of Cangyuan in the Dao Domain, a mythological system derived from what Cangyuan knew in his memory has become a world.
The foundation of this world is everything about myths in Cangyuan's memory.
Ancient times, Indian mythology, Greek pantheon, Nordic gods, Egyptian Nine Pillars, Japanese Takamagahara.
They were all contents of the mythology system that he had learned about when he was still Blue Star Lin Cang.
That is to say.
Whether it is the prehistoric Sanqing Pangu, Nuwa Houtu, Hongjun Tiandao, Brahma Shiva in India, Zeus Poseidon in Greece, etc., they were all born based on Cangyuan's memory.
However, because the mythical Daluo transcends everything, cause and effect cycle, and the avenue runs on its own, the closed logical loop turns faster and faster, and finally evolves into a complete, closed-loop, self-consistent false world.
And the Lost Court of Gods.
It was also born based on Lin Cang’s understanding of the Cthulhu mythology system in his previous life.
However, it was stolen by Emperor Cang.
Take it for yourself.
The existence of Cang Emperor is not simple either.
In fact, Emperor Cang is Lin Cang from another world.
Parallel world.
But when Cangyuan realized Daluo, all his own timelines were merged, and all of them were unified, including the parallel world where Emperor Cang lived.
However, Cangyuan itself had some problems.
That's why he didn't completely restrain Cang Emperor.
But it also paved the way for him to set off a dark tide of turmoil in the world inside his own body.
Emperor Cang was unwilling to be restrained.
He found half of the Daluo Dao Fruit in Cangyuan.
Trying to refine.
Steal the Daluo fruit of Cangyuan's true deity.
But he overestimated himself.
He also underestimated Daluo Daoguo.
After going through seven immeasurable realms and countless years, Emperor Cang was unable to do anything with the half of the Daluo Dao Fruit.
Helpless.
therefore.
Lin Cang focused on Cangyuan, who he thought had not yet awakened!
He wants to replace Cangyuan.
Become the supreme Da Luo Jinxian!
Across the Dao domain!
Everything is false.
Prehistoric times are false.
Many divine realms are false.
